title: TIAgent: From Natural Language to Grounded Agentic Workflows for Computational Pathology
abstract: arXiv:2610.32993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational pathology (CPath) analyses increasingly depend on multi-step computational workflows that require substantial programming expertise, limiting their accessibility to pathologists and other domain experts without extensive coding experience. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a promising natural-language interface for constructing such analyses, hallucinated operations and incorrect workflow specifications limit their reliability in scientific settings. We introduce Tissue Image Analysis Agent (TIAgent), an automated CPath workflow generation framework that, given a natural-language prompt specifying a complex analytical task together with an input dataset, automatically constructs a verifiable computational graph employing existing CPath operations. The resulting graph can be inspected and executed, enabling natural-language construction of complex CPath workflows for applications including automated biomarker d

translated_title: TIAgent：从自然语言到计算病理学中有据可依的智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 计算病理学（CPath）分析日益依赖于需要大量编程专业知识的多步骤计算工作流，这使得缺乏丰富编程经验的病理学家和其他领域专家难以使用这些分析。尽管大语言模型（LLM）为构建此类分析提供了一个有前景的自然语言接口，但幻觉操作和不正确的工作流规范限制了它们在科学环境中的可靠性。我们提出了组织图像分析智能体（TIAgent），这是一个自动化的CPath工作流生成框架：给定一个描述复杂分析任务的自然语言提示以及输入数据集，它能够自动构建一个由现有CPath操作组成的可验证计算图。所生成的计算图可供检查和执行，从而实现通过自然语言构建复杂的CPath工作流，应用于包括自动化生物标志物检测（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: TIAgent是一个自动化的计算病理学工作流生成框架，它将自然语言任务描述锚定到现有CPath操作上，自动构建可验证的计算图，使没有编程经验的病理学家也能可靠地构建复杂的多步分析流程。
en_tdlr: TIAgent automatically constructs verifiable computational graphs for computational pathology by grounding natural-language prompts in existing CPath operations, enabling reliable, coding-free construction of complex multi-step analysis workflows for domain experts.
